response.sql:
WITH site_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(CASE WHEN sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL AND sm.geomdeltamm > 0
        THEN sm.facetresmm / sm.geomdeltamm 
        END) as site_avg_ratio,
    COUNT(sm.facetregistry) as mesh_count
  FROM sites s
  INNER JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
site_stats_valid AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM site_stats
  WHERE site_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    insurstat,
    AVG(site_avg_ratio) as status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_stats_valid
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
above_average_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.insurstat,
    ss.site_avg_ratio,
    sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_stats_valid ss
  JOIN status_averages sa ON ss.insurstat = sa.insurstat
  WHERE ss.site_avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  insurstat,
  AVG(site_avg_ratio) as above_avg_sites_average_ratio,
  COUNT(*) as above_avg_sites_count,
  AVG(site_avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) as average_excess
FROM above_average_sites
GROUP BY insurstat

assumptions.assumption: Records where geomdeltamm is NULL, zero, or negative are excluded from the ratio calculation. Zero and negative values are treated as undefined/invalid (division by zero or negative geometric deviation is not meaningful), consistent with the instruction to ignore missing ratios and prevent mathematical errors.
